task.description:
Test design for PRM-06/07/08/09 batch. Produce runnable integration tests that cover every MUST and SHOULD acceptance criterion. PRM-06/07 are MUST — must have integration tests, no `error.SkipZigTest`, no hardcoded UUIDs.

Actual implementation file paths (design used `src/promotion/*` but BACKEND-DEV placed them under `src/definition/*`):
- src/definition/assertion_rerun.zig — applyPromotionAssertionRerun(), buildIdempotencyKey(), RunStatus enum
- src/definition/sandbox_pool.zig — SandboxPool, claim()/release(), SandboxClaim
- src/definition/fixture_loader.zig — loadFixturesOnly(), FixtureLoadError, ALLOWLIST
- src/definition/rollback.zig — rollbackDefinitionVersion(), RollbackResult, RollbackError
- src/definition/pack_update.zig — computePackUpdatePlan(), PackUpdatePlan, ArtefactClassification enum
- src/api/routes/promotion_assertion.zig — handleRunAssertions() HTTP handler
- src/api/routes/definition_rollback.zig — handleRollback() HTTP handler
- src/bpm.zig — re-exports the above via bpm.promotion_assertion_rerun, bpm.sandbox_pool, etc.

Migrations:
- migrations/1156_prm06_promotion_assertion_runs.sql (promotion_assertion_runs per-tenant table; UNIQUE(tenant_id, idempotency_key))
- migrations/1157_prm09_solution_pack_update.sql (solution_pack_installs + solution_pack_artefact_bases + pack_update_resolutions in public)

Acceptance criteria (verbatim from docs/requirements.yaml):
PRM-06 (MUST):
  AC1 — replay twice with same (review_id, plan_digest) returns cached outcome and does NOT claim a second sandbox
  AC2 — sandbox contains only rows named in fixtures[] (organic rows excluded)
  AC3 — replay twice with same artifact produces identical result sets after stripping non_deterministic_fields
  AC4 — assertion failure -> status='failed', review moves approved->failed, HTTP 422 with failing ids, target active version unchanged
  AC5 — no sandbox free within 60s -> HTTP 503 SandboxUnavailable, review remains 'approved'
PRM-07 (MUST):
  AC1 — assertions passed + release fails -> promotion applies, status='teardown_failed', PROMOTION_ASSERTION_TEARDOWN_FAILED appended
  AC2 — replay panics -> release still invoked
  AC3 — teardown failure -> GET /api/v1/promotions/{id} names failed teardown and sandbox_id
  AC4 — teardown failure NEVER sets promotion_reviews.status='failed' and never blocks version pointer move
  AC5 — leaked sandbox reaped -> reclamation recorded against same run
PRM-08 (SHOULD):
  AC1 — V2 active, V1 was active before -> rollback to V1 -> active pointer V1, DEFINITION_VERSION_ROLLED_BACK appended, no DDL
  AC2 — instances started under V2 continue on their PD-08 snapshot, pinned_versions[] unchanged
  AC3 — version never active -> HTTP 422 VersionNeverActive
  AC4 — successful rollback -> promotion_reviews row that applied V2 moves to 'superseded' with superseded_by naming event
  AC5 — non-platform-admin caller -> HTTP 403
PRM-09 (SHOULD):
  AC1 — pack P at Vb installed, tenant unmodified, Vn offered -> every changed artefact = clean_update
  AC2 — tenant modified D after Vb, Vn also changes D -> D classified conflict; plan carries base/local/incoming; apply without resolution -> HTTP 409 UnresolvedTemplateConflict naming D
  AC3 — conflict artefact + keep_local resolution -> tenant's artefact byte-identical; TEMPLATE_UPDATE_CONFLICT_RESOLVED appended; recorded base advances to Vn
  AC4 — local_only artefact -> not touched; reported as retained
  AC5 — install record for Vb absent -> every artefact tenant holds -> conflict (cannot prove no modification)
  AC6 — conflict without resolution -> PRM-02 reject before any transaction opens

Spec & tests must satisfy:
- Every MUST req (PRM-06, PRM-07) has at least one runnable integration test
- Every SHOULD req (PRM-08, PRM-09) has at least one runnable integration test
- Spec case count matches test `test "..."` block count exactly
- Tests connect to real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL; fail clearly if env var missing
- Per-test UUIDs (no hardcoded literals); deferred cleanup on every test block
- No mocks/stubs/fakes for integration tests
- parameterised SQL only (no string concat into SQL except for the DDL strings that use $1/$2 binds)
- No hardcoded credentials

Validation gates before declaring PASS:
1. zig build test exits 0
2. python tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration exits 0 (no BLOCKER)
3. python tools/lint_handoffs.py exits 0
4. Every MUST requirement (PRM-06, PRM-07) has at least one integration test that would fail if the requirement were violated (fail-first confirmed via temporary revert)
5. Spec case count == test case count

Update handoff with:
- status: COMPLETED, result.status: PASS
- result.artifacts_out: list of created test spec + test files with line counts
- result.summary: AC coverage table (requirement/AC/test mapping)
- result.issues: empty if no blockers; MINOR/MEDIUM where the implementation diverges from the requirement (e.g. PRM-07 AC3 requires GET endpoint surfacing — backend-dev's route only writes; PRM-09 AC2 requires UnresolvedTemplateConflict HTTP 409 mapping in PRM-02 — backend-dev's pack_update.zig only returns has_unresolved_conflicts in plan; document the gap)
- completed_at: ISO8601 UTC timestamp
- git_evidence.branch_name: feature/WF02-prm-batch1-20260814

result.summary: Test spec + 3 integration test files written and wired into build.zig. Compile-time verified: PRM-08 + PRM-09 tests compile cleanly. PRM-06/07 tests fail to compile due to BLOCKER defects in implementation commit b386ff3f (zig 0.16 incompatibilities + PoolError switch gap + HashMap null value). Filed as GH-780. Per TEST-DESIGNER rules, these are infrastructure blockers — not test-design gaps.
artifacts_out: build.zig (added test-integration-prm06-07, test-integration-prm08, test-integration-prm09 steps; wired into test_integration_others_step umbrella)

issues.title: PRM-06..09 batch — implementation compile errors BLOCK test compilation (zig 0.16 incompatibilities)
details: 1. assertion_rerun.zig:210 — PoolError switch maps only PoolExhausted; other variants cause compile error.
2. sandbox_pool.zig:59 — self.mutex.lock() — zig 0.16 removed blocking .lock() from std.atomic.Mutex.
4. pack_update.zig:204 — base_contents.put(aid_copy, null) — map value type mismatch.

result.next_action: Request ORCH to spawn an ADHOC handoff (BACKEND-DEV) to fix the 4 compile defects in commit b386ff3f. After fixes, TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR can validate and TEST-RUNNER can execute.
